title: Number of Pairs of Interchangeable Rectangles
goal: Count pairs of rectangles with the same width-to-height ratio.
strategy: Reduce each width and height by their greatest common divisor. Every earlier rectangle with the same reduced pair forms one new interchangeable pair.
